HEADLINE
Streamline client communication and project management

SUBHEADLINE
For dev agency owners, manually tracking client feedback across multiple channels.

WHAT THIS IS
A focused tool that helps dev agency owners move from manually tracking client feedback across multiple  to streamline client communication and project manage.

WHO IT IS FOR
Dev agency owners

THE PROBLEM
Manually tracking client feedback across multiple channels

WHY EXISTING TOOLS FAIL
Spreadsheets was not designed for dev agency owners. It covers the broader category but lacks the specific mechanics this problem requires, forcing dev agency owners to patch gaps with manual workarounds that slow outcomes.

HOW IT WORKS
Automates task ticket creation from diverse feedback sources.

KEY BENEFITS
Early users of Client Feedback Manager reach their first outcome without the overhead of general-purpose alternatives.

CALL TO ACTION
Get started with Client Feedback Manager.
